title: fix(app-shell): interface pages open records again — configurable drawer / page / none
body:
## Summary
**Regression fix.** `InterfaceListPage` never passed a record-click handler or navigation config to `ListView`, so clicking a row / title / card on **any** interface-page visualization (grid, kanban, gallery, calendar, timeline, gantt, map) did nothing — records were dead. (Object views were unaffected; only the interface pages added this session.)

Wires record-opening the way `ObjectView` does, and makes it **author-configurable** via `interfaceConfig.recordAction`:
- **`drawer`** (default) — right-side peek panel rendering the record's real detail page (`RecordDetailView`), URL-driven via `?recordId=…` (shareable, survives refresh).
- **`page`** — full-page navigate to the record route.
- **`modal`** — overlay.
- **`none`** — rows not clickable.

Cmd/Ctrl/middle-click always opens in a new tab.

## Verification
Clicking a task on Task Triage opens the drawer with the full record detail (path stepper + highlights + Overview/Schedule/Details); `?recordId=` round-trips; tsc clean.

Pairs with objectstack-ai/framework#TBD (adds `recordAction` to InterfacePageConfig + the page form select).
